remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600 -DWINVER=0x600)

add_definitions(-D_ADVAPI32_ -D_ADVAPI32_VISTA_)
spec2def(advapi32_vista.dll advapi32_vista.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

include_directories(
    ../advapi32
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/../advapi32
)

# advapi32_vista.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/advapi32_vista-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(advapi32_vista_shims OBJECT DllMain.c ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/dll/win32/advapi32/reg/reg.c)
target_link_libraries(advapi32_vista_shims PRIVATE wine libadvapi32 libkernel32 libntdll)
add_dependencies(advapi32_vista_shims psdk advapi32)
add_cargo_module(advapi32_vista advapi32_vista-cargo advapi32_vista.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS advapi32_vista_shims psdk)
